summary: Boat-ramp car park beside Nudgee Creek, mangroves all round, no homes.

drivers.seclusion: Mangrove and creek bank on all sides; no dwellings mapped or seen.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road curls down to a gravel apron where cars and trailers park; room for a van.
drivers.convention: Cars, utes and trailers parked; boat launch use, no campers seen.

flags: Pin is in the creek, so the spot is a nearby car park
Very low-lying: about 0 m elevation by tidal Nudgee Creek, flood and king tide risk
sun_shade: Largely open with scattered trees; afternoon sun from the west over the creek.
cannot_judge: Surface firmness of the gravel apron

best_section.where: Gravel and sealed bay about 60 m north-east of the pin, at the creek-side end of the ramp road
